messages:
zoe: Restore jobs failing with KMS AccessDenied during snapshot decrypts for tenant-9. Error: 'kms:Decrypt AccessDenied' on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cmk-9abc

rahul: Which key alias? any recent rotations or IAM changes?

zoe: Key was rotated to alias/backup-tenant-main last week. IAM pipeline ran an iam-tighten job an hour before failures.

gabi: sec-bot, show IAM change details for role backup-runner around 2026-03-22T11:00Z

sec-bot: iam-tighten pipeline removed kms:Decrypt from role backup-runner at 2026-03-22T11:02:07Z (change-id: iam-20260322-77). Audit link: https://ci.redwood/iam/changes/iam-20260322-77

oncall-ops: Immediate step: re-add scoped kms:Decrypt to role backup-runner for affected CMK ARN as an inline emergency fix; follow with MR for managed policy.

rahul: I'll apply inline allow now and include justification. Then run a test restore.

sec-bot: Inline change recorded. Please ensure change TTL <= 2 hours and MR created.

oncall-ops: Restore test succeeded after hotfix. Logs: 'KMS Decrypt Success' and job finished.

zue: (typo) zoe: Good. Post-incident actions: 1) inventory snapshots for mixed keys, 2) add pipeline lint to prevent removal of kms:Decrypt from tagged restore roles, 3) prototype grant-based ephemeral decrypts for restore controller.

gabi: Also add CloudTrail metric filter for KMS Decrypt AccessDenied to surface in alerts.

rahul: I'll open MR to replace inline fix with least-privileged managed policy and add unit test simulating restore in CI.

sec-bot: Noted action items. Closing hotfix after MR merged.

zoe: Thanks. Will follow up with customer notification and postmortem.
